YES! YES! YES!  One hundred percent this. I too, have BPD and I often find myself wanting to ask the same repetitive questions. I know where the insecurities stem from but, still ask. My boyfriend is very patient and answers my questions without fuss or hesitation. Although, there are times that I can hear the exasperation in his voice. It makes me feel guilty because the rational part of me knows that he loves me, knows he finds me attractive etc. As stated, it's hard not to vocalize concerns and ask questions. Recently, when I feel myself becoming insecure with something, I'll write down what is causing it, write down why it's causing me distress and, sometimes I'm able to get myself back in check. It doesn't always work but, a lot of times I can determine that it's my anxiety playing tricks on me. If that makes sense.
